attr.title: Maze Mice
attr.desc: Maze Mice is a bullet heaven roguelite where time only moves when you move. Collect dots, level up, choose upgrades, and avoid cats. All at your own pace.
attr.inst: Download from Steam and copy Maze Mice.pck into the mazemice folder
attr.inst_md:
Download from [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385370/Maze_Mice/)
and copy Maze Mice.pck into the mazemice folder
